component.name: Luti Color Picker
component.summary: Capture screen colors and keep a visual history

description.p: Capture colors with a magnifier, browse your visual history, create palettes and gradients, and extract dominant colors from images.
Start in the system tray at login and open the main window when launched manually.
Improve clipboard reliability when copying colors and gradients.
Highlight passing and failing contrast results in green and red.
Check WCAG text contrast and generate eleven shades with an Oklab color scale.
Enable minimized startup and startup at login by default on supported installations.
Start the application minimized with a new Settings option.
Match palette dialogs to the application theme.
List shades with copy and palette actions on each row.
Show shades in a pop-up and let users copy, edit, and view shades of palette colors.
Select a shade from history and add it to a palette.
Show and copy lighter and darker shades of a selected history color.
Follow the pointer across multiple monitors during color capture.
Keep color capture responsive when an application dialog is open.
Match dropdown menus to the application theme.
Match the About title bar to the main window.
Match the Settings title bar to the main window.
Edit gradient stop colors directly by entering their HEX codes.
Add AppImage update metadata and desktop notifications for new stable releases.
Standardize the tray menu and desktop launcher labels in English.

ul.li: Register a global shortcut to capture colors.
Open the magnifier at the pointer and configure its zoom limits.
Add history colors directly to the selected palette or choose a palette each time.
Play distinct sounds for capture and copy.
